description:
Software + AI pricing isn't public, so searching the internet won't tell you if you're overpaying. Tropic will.

Connect Tropic to ChatGPT to benchmark your pricing against $18B+ in verified technology spend, access negotiation playbooks from 100,000+ real deals, and get supplier intelligence on competitors and contract terms. Upload a proposal, ask if you're getting a good price, and go into your next negotiation with real leverage.

Your existing Tropic permissions apply. You only see data you're authorized to access in the Tropic app.

defaultPrompt: How is my pricing for 80 Gong Professional seats for $104,000?
